column1: # Names a request schema of this contract must not ask a caller for (INV-REQ-804 behavior 2: no request field carries an
# IRAS category code, a submission type or a scope verdict; INV-AC-1859). resubmission and RESUBMISSION come from
# INV-AC-2030 (no field or enum value classifies an amendment as resubmission or credit note; an amendment is only a
# sourceRevision under the same sourceKey, INV-REQ-794).
# reserved_in names the components.schemas entry where the published contract still carries the item as an optional
# property whose description starts with Reserved: (INV-Q-6490); a non-empty value is refused by the System.
# There is deliberately no row for CREDIT_NOTE, INVOICE or DEBIT_NOTE: they name the kind of a document. Operations
# that classify an amendment are not name-checkable and stay with review.
